reading.title: Packing, lighting and refreshments
reading.text: The water bottle carries drinking water. Backpack is a bag worn on the back, rain poncho a loose rain garment, and portable charger a stored-power device for compatible electronics. The visitor packs the bottle rather than assuming all containers are suitable for drinking water. String lights are small lights connected along a wire. Fireworks are pyrotechnic displays handled through authorized professional arrangements, live music is in-person musical performance, and dance rhythmic body movement. The account describes the decorative light strand. The magician performs illusions. Face paint is decorative cosmetic material, clown a comic performer, and corn dog a battered sausage on a stick. These terms separate roles, materials and food; cosmetic suitability depends on actual product directions. Funnel cake is a fried-batter pastry in this food display. Pretzel is a twisted baked snack, and candy apple an apple with a hard sweet coating. The visitor compares the foods and asks for actual ingredient information before choosing.
